Regulation: B.C. Reg. 111/2026
Made under: Skilled Trades Bc Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 6, 2026

B.C. Reg. 111/2026, deposited July 6, 2026, under theSKILLED TRADES BC ACT[sections 27 (2) and 50 (1)]. Ministerial Order M268/2026, dated July 6, 2026. I, Jessie Sunner, Minister of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills, order that the Minister’s Skilled Trades BC Regulation, B.C. Reg. 256/2022, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — J. SUNNER,Minister of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills. 1	Section 4 of the Minister’s Skilled Trades BC Regulation, B.C. Reg. 256/2022, is amended by striking out ", effective December 1, 2023". 2	Section 2 of the Schedule is amended (a)	by renumbering the section as section 2 (1), (b)	in subsection (1) by adding "following" after "each of the" and by striking out "trades set out in this schedule" and substituting "trades", and (c)	by adding the following subsection: (2)	The applicable scope of work set out in this Schedule applies in respect of each of the following skilled trades certification trades, effective July 5, 2027: 3	The following sections are added to the Schedule: "luffing boom"means a boom that is raised and lowered about a pivot point to change the load radius; "tower crane"means a tower crane that (a)	uses a horizontal, articulated or luffing boom to lift, position and place loads, and (i)	a tower crane erected on site from component parts; (ii)	a self-erecting tower crane with a lift capacity of more than 10 t. (2)	The prescribed scope of work for a tower crane operator consists of the following: (a)	operating a tower crane to lift, position and place loads; (b)	performing pre-operational equipment checks and limit tests in respect of a tower crane. 12(1)	In this section,"mobile crane"means a crane that (a)	is friction-driven or hydraulic-driven,

minutes_briefs.title: Tower crane operator certification scope of work takes effect July 5, 2027 in BC
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended its Skilled Trades BC Regulation to add a new certified trade: tower crane operator. The change defines the scope of work for tower crane operators, including operating tower cranes and performing pre-operational checks. This new certification requirement takes effect on July 5, 2027, giving businesses time to prepare.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you employ tower crane operators, plan to ensure they are certified under the new trade by July 5, 2027.

key_dates.label: Tower crane operator certification scope of work takes effect (BC)
